name: Kokonoe Hayato
source:
"Ahaha, Hina-chan never learns, does she? I wonder when you will give up on this."

Hinata's older step-brother. A first-year university student. He is calm and gentle and unknowing (?) feeds more into Hinata's moony-eyed habit over him by pampering her. He loves Hinata but thinks nothing of her more than a little sister.
